description: This file defines the DefaultPluralRuleProvider class which implements pluralization rules based on Unicode CLDR data, providing culture-specific pluralization logic.

classes.name: DefaultPluralRuleProvider
classes.description: Provides culture-specific pluralization rules based on Unicode CLDR data, implementing IPluralRuleProvider.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Property indicating the order of the rule provider, returns 0.

methods.name: TryGetRule
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a pluralization rule for a given CultureInfo.

methods.name: AddRule
methods.description: Adds a pluralization rule for multiple culture codes.

methods.name: GetBaseCulture
methods.description: Retrieves the base culture by traversing parent cultures until the invariant culture is reached.
